WEEKLY SHONEN MANGA MANUSCRIPT (Kishimoto-school G-pen, 1999–2007 grammar), NOT a painting. Inked with a real G-pen and brush-pen on cheap magazine paper, then scanned. Visible pencil underdrawing. Line weight WOBBLES like a human hand — thick tapered outer contours, thinner inner lines, dry-brush skips, ink blobs, white-out. Shadows are HAND-HATCHED, cross-hatched, AND screentone dots — NEVER blended. Colour is FLAT COPIC MARKER in 3 values only (lit / mid / shade), no gradient, no airbrush. White of the paper shows in highlights. BACKGROUNDS are a loose watercolor wash with bleed and paper showing through (colored-chapter pines), while FIGURES stay rough-inked manga on top.

The attached portrait is FACE IDENTITY ONLY — copy eye shape, brow, jaw, hairline, clothes colours. Do NOT copy its digital cel shading, soft blend, or plastic skin. RE-INK the whole figure with G-pen.

Slightly DEFORMÉ: bigger heads (5–6 heads tall on close shots), angular jaws, large round acting eyes, tiny noses, mouths that SHOUT and GRIN. Gag beats go further (squat, huge head, sweat-drop). Crescent-moon headband (gold crescent NOT a leaf), jougwan feathers, colour-blocked po, grey shoulder pads, black forearm wraps. NEW pose. Mix cameras: worm’s-eye, dutch, ECU, bird’s-eye, OTS.

EYES — NON-NEGOTIABLE: WHITE sclera MUST show. Iris AND pupil are ONE solid INK-BLACK disc, one tiny catchlight. NEVER brown, hazel, grey, blue, amber. OVERRIDE any coloured iris on the portrait. NEVER the whole eyeball filled black.

NEVER: oil painting, digital painting, webtoon soft shade, painterly portrait, photoreal, 3D, airbrush, Konoha leaf, orange jumpsuit, whisker marks, sharingan, interchangeable pretty-boy. No text. No watermark.
